analysis.description: The paper addresses the mismatch between the classical MDP framework in reinforcement learning and real-time environments. It introduces Real-Time Reinforcement Learning (RTRL) to improve decision-making where states and actions evolve simultaneously. Under this new framework, the Real-Time Actor-Critic (RTAC) is presented as an algorithm that outperforms existing methods in both real-time and non-real-time settings.

type.justification: The paper proposes a new theoretical framework and provides a theoretical analysis of existing algorithms under this framework.
type.quote: In this paper, we introduce a new framework, in which states and actions evolve simultaneously and show how it is related to the classical MDP formulation.
